{{Quote|We have the source, Magister, Panoply Orbital Facility.''"''<br />''"''Rendezvous with the rest of your team and execute the assault.|A Sun Guard and Hego Damask|<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
The '''Panoply Orbital Facility''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Pax Teem]] sent agents of [[Santhe Security]] to capture Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], an allie of Teem's rival [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]]. Teem allowed a decoy signal from him to be traced by Damask's [[Sun Guard]]s, to trick them into believing that Teem was on the Panoply Orbital Facility, and Damask dispatched the bulk of his Guards to attack the station. Teem was in fact on Coruscant proper, and the deception allowed the Gran to stage an [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attempt]] on Damask's life.
